newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian brothel bloodbath leaves seven dead.
newsitem.headline: Colombian brothel bloodbath leaves seven dead.

text.p: Gunmen stormed a brothel in southwest Colombia early on Saturday and killed seven people, including two prostitutes and their madame, police said.
The shoot-out took place as clients and prostitutes were drinking and having sex in a working-class district of Cali, Colombia's second largest city.

Deputy police chief Col. Benigno Pineiro said the attack appeared to be linked to the "white slave trade" and was sparked by the "massage parlour" owner's failure to pay a debt to an organisation that supplied her with young prostitutes.
The gang of five men armed with guns shot to death a security guard and stormed the brothel in a hail of bullets.
Three men believed to be clients were killed. Four other people were wounded, including a 17-year-old prostitute who was hit in the head by three bullets, police said.
Gory images broadcast on Colombian TV showed semi-clothed bodies carried out of the building on stretchers and blood spattered around the brothel's walls and over pink sofas.
"There was a shoot-out in a massage parlour and seven people died and four others were badly injured. Five men broke in as the women were attending their clients," a Cali police spokesman said.
"These places are called massage parlours but they are in fact prostitution establishments. I don't think anybody was having a bona fide massage at that time in the morning."
